notes: Item 19 contains two tables. Table 1 reports systemwide aggregate revenue by type for the 2025 calendar year across all franchised salons that operated at any point during the period (total count not specified). Table 2 reports per-outlet annual revenue for 126 locations that operated for the entire 2025 Measurement Period, broken into four revenue quartiles with average, median, high, and low figures. Systemwide totals in Table 1 are not per-outlet averages. The individual salon-level detail rows in Q1-Q4 tables were not individually extracted as separate records due to schema limitations, but the quartile summary statistics (avg, median, min, max) are fully captured. Confidence slightly reduced because Table 1 values are systemwide aggregates rather than per-outlet metrics, which may be less useful for breakeven analysis.
